'''Florinda Showers''' (Japanese: '''リンドウ・ムラサメ''' ''Lindow Murasame'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP068|Make Room for Gloom]]'', as well as in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]].

==In animation==
===''Pokémon the Series''===
===={{aniseries|OS}}====
Florinda owns the [[Xanadu Nursery]], after inheriting it from her parents. She takes care of the plants there, and gives them her utmost attention and care. She is also an expert on plants of the [[Pokémon world]], and those with special properties that can affect {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She cares very much for her plants, declaring that they are like "children" to her, and cares as much for her Gloom. Since she runs the Nursery for her parents, she feels that they expect a lot from her, thus giving her a few confidence issues. She is very sweet and gentle, but too self-pitying. Her employee is [[Potter]], who she has a crush on and who has a crush on her, though both are unaware of each other's feelings.

Her confidence issues seem to have begun when she tried using a [[Leaf Stone]] on her {{p|Gloom}}. She thought that even with the Evolution Stone, she was not able to [[Evolution|evolve]] her Gloom because of not {{pkmn|training}} it properly enough, although she already helped it develop an antidote for some of the plants that exist in the garden. She reciprocated these confidence issues with her running the nursery. She later discovered that the Leaf Stone she used was fake, upon close scrutiny by {{an|Brock}}, who had become smitten with her. They then realized that it was {{TRT}}'s doing, though Florinda blamed herself for being so gullible, even calling herself useless.

She had trained her Gloom well enough and thoroughly properly, though, and she realized her potential when Team Rocket stole [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{status|Paralysis|paralyzed}} everyone except for her and her Gloom with Stun Stem, a plant located in the nursery. With some encouragement from Brock, Florinda gathered the confidence she needed to defeat Team Rocket and save Pikachu. Afterwards, she learns of Potter's feelings for her and reciprocates them, much to Brock's dismay.

|desc=Florinda Showers' {{p|Gloom}} lived at the [[Xanadu Nursery]]. It first appeared when {{an|Brock}} thought he saw a beautiful woman, though all {{Ash}} saw was Gloom. It later appeared when [[Ash's Bulbasaur]] sniffed "Stun Stem", paralyzing it. Since Gloom had already developed an immunity to the plant, it helped Bulbasaur to the treatment room. In the end, Bulbasaur recovered with the help of a liquid in Gloom's flower. It was revealed that its owner wanted to [[Evolution|evolve]] it with a [[Leaf Stone]], but it did not work; the Leaf Stone turned out to be fake.

When {{TRT}} attacked, using a powder made from the Stun Stem to stop the group, Florinda and Gloom were the only ones unaffected. Gloom confronted Team Rocket as they sent out {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}}. Gloom initially couldn't see anything from the smoke Weezing caused, but it used {{m|Double Team}} to confuse them. It then finished them off with a {{m|Solar Beam}}, sending them blasting off.

It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP225|Bulbasaur... the Ambassador!]]''.

Gloom's known moves are {{m|Double Team}} and {{m|Solar Beam}}.}}

==In the manga==
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
[[File:Florinda Showers EToP.png|180px|thumb|Florinda in The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]
Florinda appears in ''[[ET11|Days of Gloom and Glory]]''. Her family lived in a house for many generations until it sank into the sea. Similarly to in {{aniseries|OS}}, she was tricked by Team Rocket into buying Leaf Stones. Potter would go to such lengths as to dive into the sea to retrieve her things. She finds an abandoned baby {{p|Meowth}} and adopts it. Eventually Team Rocket come back to steal all of her Gloom, but she commands them to all use {{m|Solar Beam}}, which sends Team Rocket blasting off.
